question: What engineering change, intervention, or design would prevent or mitigate the stated failure under the stated constraint, and what concrete test would falsify the proposed approach?
pipeline_answer:
Anisotropic lithium-ion transport across different facets of faceted nickel-rich NMC cathode particles, driven by interparticle communication and heterogeneous lithiation states.

Implement a facet-aware, temperature-compensated balancing algorithm in the BMS that dynamically adjusts charge/discharge C-rates based on real-time module thermal gradient (15°C) to mitigate anisotropic diffusion heterogeneity, combined with periodic high-state-of-charge rest cycles to force equilibration of interparticle communication channels.

Homogenization of lithium distribution across cathode particles within each cell, reducing intrinsic cell-to-cell capacity drift and self-discharge spread, thereby keeping voltage spread below 35 mV under thermal gradients.

Measure cell voltage spread after 500 cycles under a steady 15°C thermal gradient; if spread exceeds 35 mV at rest, the mechanism fails to mitigate anisotropic diffusion effects sufficiently.
